properties.name: RICHMOND ST / CHILVER RD
properties.reason: City PXO web listing vs nearby OSM. Same physical road arm and exact geometry must be confirmed; a nearby crossing does not prove this PXO matches.
properties.source_independence: City listing and city GIS share one publisher; OSM is a separate data source. No independent ground survey.
properties.proposed_review_action: Identify the photographed arm and split the crossing ring if needed; update only confirmed segment/node. Photo date unknown; geometry source permission unresolved.
properties.case_note: The official photograph shows a marked crossing, while four nearby OSM nodes are tagged unmarked/no. Way 1395959062 forms a closed loop around multiple road arms. Identify the photographed arm and split the way if appropriate; do not retag the entire loop. The photograph date is unknown.

properties.proposed_review_action: Recheck each approach; if there are warning flashers only, review crossing=traffic_signals and associated traffic_signals attributes. No automatic mass rewrite.
properties.case_note: The official photograph shows a pedestrian crossover with amber warning flashers; nearby OSM data uses crossing=traffic_signals. Verify whether there are actual pedestrian red/green signals. A push button or amber flasher alone does not establish a signal-controlled crossing.
